pages.title: Tesla Powerwall 3 Cost in California (2026): Price, Rebates
pages.note: Adds 'Powerwall 2 vs Powerwall 3' (datasheets + Tesla support: 5 vs 11.5 kW, 106 vs 185 LRA, integrated inverter) and 'Which rebates apply to a Powerwall in California': Tesla Next Million rebate (registration closed 6/30/2026, claims by 12/31/2026), PG&E $7,500 (179 left 9/18), SMUD (cut to $300/kWh on 9/23/2026), SDCP, CPA, Anaheim, 3CE (closed 3/19/2026). Table now lists rebates; the old payment-path table content is kept in the tax section. Tesla's incentives page is stale (lists 3CE, SMUD $8,000) and still says Powerwall 'is designed to qualify for the Federal ITC'; the page says the IRS rule governs owned 2026 installs. Title adds 'Rebates'. Next-question links added to src/data/json-article-links.ts.
